spec.x-sdk-authentication-policy: Choose one explicit access mode before requesting: no credentials (the report URL is a sensitive capability), the four company API1 headers together, or the company API2 Bearer. Never retry with another scheme after a refusal and never send credentials to an origin other than https://api.webmania.com.br.

x-auth-origin-policy.redirects: Never follow with credentials. Reauthorize a new origin explicitly.
x-auth-origin-policy.capability: The complete report URL authorizes one exported report and is sensitive. Do not log it or attach credentials to a URL outside the approved origin and path prefix.

spec.x-sdk-transfer-policy: Preserve status, media type and raw bytes. Accept a file only after its bytes match the declared format (ZIP local-file signature for ZIP and XLSX, a PDF header for PDF, text for CSV, HTML and XML). A JSON body with an error property is a failure even at HTTP 200.
